newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker continue to dip on crudes, cargo.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker continue to dip on crudes, cargo.

text.p: Singapore bunker was indicated lower on Tuesday, continuing the downtrend seen on Monday along with lower crudes and fuel oil cargo values, traders said.

A major said 180-cst should go under $124 a tonne from Monday's $126 with independents seeing levels dipping to $120. Majors said 380-cst has been traded as low as $116 and levels should hover between that level and $118 Tuesday.
One trader said the arrival of several fuel oil cargoes would pressure prices at least until Friday.
MDO and gasoil were slightly softer to steady at $210-$226 and $235-$240 respectively.--Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
